overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The Pier Manager, not the Board, created the dockage committee, which was advisory to him on a matter within his sole authority and so fell under the Connelly exception. Two allegations were declined as outside the Law or untimely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board created a dockage review subcommittee that was subject to the Open Meeting Law and had to post notices and keep minutes.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that the Board itself created the Committee; the fact that the Board referred to the Committee as a “subcommittee,” alone, is not determinative.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the dockage committee failed to post meeting notices or create and approve minutes, as a public body would have to.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Committee, created by the Pier Manager to advise him on a task he could have accomplished by himself entirely free from the requirements of the Open Meeting Law, falls within the Connelly exception and is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee changed the 2020 dockage application criteria outside an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we find no evidence that the Committee deliberated regarding changes to the application criteria, only that the Committee assisted the Pier Manager in reviewing the applications received.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to post meeting minutes to a website.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that public bodies post meeting minutes to a website.

allegations.summary: Complaint challenged the sufficiency of the Board's January 14 meeting notice and a Board member's meeting with pier tenants.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review any allegations related to the sufficiency of the Board’s January 14 meeting notice or a Board member meeting with pier tenants, which meeting was discussed during the January 14 meeting, as those allegations were not timely filed with the Bord.
